claimDispositions.reason: Academic Integrity Policy prohibits AI-generated content submission without explicit permission and attribution.
Historic Globot/Gecko vendor reference is not confirmed on current official UCD IT services; excluded from current conclusions and retained for historical traceability.
Gemini web app access provided under Google Workspace for Education; standalone paid upgrades unverified.
Copilot Chat accessible with UCD Connect accounts under enterprise data protection; independent paid student subscription unverified.
NotebookLM available via Google Workspace license; prompt and response data recorded for compliance.
Zoom AI Companion is optional meeting feature enabled only by host or co-host with participant notification.
Faculty Guidelines require module descriptors to clearly state whether student AI use is permissible and under what conditions.
Faculty Guidelines establish entering personal data into non-supported tools breaches GDPR; assignments and exam scripts constitute personal data.
Eight UMT-approved principles govern institutional AI use across ethics, transparency, and human oversight.
Teaching and Learning guidance advises educators to be transparent about permitted AI use and apply robust designs.
Library guide provides best practice recommendations on citing AI, prompt logging, and critical fact-checking.

gaps: Historic Gecko AI chatbot pilot is not confirmed on current IT Services active features; active pilot status and completed DPIA remain unverified policy gaps.
Student subscription costs, premium tiers, and standalone feature upgrades for Google Gemini and Microsoft Copilot are unverified in official IT documentation.
Faculty guidelines prohibit instructors from requiring tools not provided by UCD, and prohibit AI detection software for misconduct monitoring; universal GenAI penalty tariffs remain unverified.

Formal faculty investigation workflows and committee sanction outcome schedules under UCD Student Academic Misconduct Procedures are not fully evidenced by the 10 working days appeal checklist excerpt.

cl-university-college-dublin-zoom-ai-com.text: Zoom AI Companion is listed for University College Dublin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: UCD Zoom accounts can use AI meeting summaries, but the host or co-host must turn the optional feature on for each meeting.

coursework:ucd-coursework-permission-gro.text: UCD’s Academic Integrity Policy says submission of AI-generated content without explicit permission and attribution is not allowed.
coursework:ucd-coursework-permission-gro.summaryZh: 未经明确许可和归属不得提交AI生成内容
coursework:ucd-coursework-permission-gro.scope: All undergraduate and taught postgraduate modules

evidence.quote: Accordingly, submission of AI-generated content without explicit permission and attribution is not allowed.

exams:ucd-exams-assessment-design-group.text: The retained teaching guidance emphasizes being transparent with students about what AI use is permitted.
exams:ucd-exams-assessment-design-group.summaryZh: 考试AI使用由具体评估设计决定且须透明告知

evidence.quote: the key is being transparent with students about what AI use is permitted.

disclosure:ucd-disclosure-records-group.text: Library guidance advises keeping detailed records of AI interactions, including prompts and outputs.
disclosure:ucd-disclosure-records-group.summaryZh: 保留完整AI交互记录并按学院规范引用披露

privacy_data:ucd-privacy-gdpr-ban-group.text: UCD faculty teaching guidance states that entering personal data into GenAI tools not supported or approved by the University constitutes a GDPR breach and is prohibited.

evidence.quote: Personal data entered into GenAI tools not supported/approved by the University constitutes a breach of GDPR and is therefore prohibited.

approved_tools:ucd-tools-gemini-workspac.text: UCD IT Services enables staff and students to access the Gemini web app via Google Workspace accounts; access does not confer coursework clearance.
approved_tools:ucd-tools-gemini-workspac.summaryZh: 提供受机构数据保护的Google Gemini与Copilot访问

evidence.quote: All UCD staff and students may access the Gemini web app with their Google Workspace accounts via UCD Connect .

research_publication:ucd-research-attrib.text: UCD’s Academic Integrity Policy prohibits students from presenting work they did not write, code, or create as their own.
research_publication:ucd-research-attrib.summaryZh: 学术诚信政策禁止将非本人编写之AI产出冒充原创提交

evidence.quote: This academic integrity policy prohibits students from representing work as their own that they did not write, code or create.

academic_integrity:ucd-appeals-ten-days-.text: Student appeals guidelines instruct students to verify that the appeal form is submitted within 10 working days from the date after the decision was communicated.
academic_integrity:ucd-appeals-ten-days-.summaryZh: 学术不端处理程序与10个工作日申诉期限

evidence.quote: Checked that you are submitting the form within 10 working days from the date after the decision was communicated to you.
evidence.location: Student Appeals Guide, Check Form Submission

teaching_guidance:ucd-teaching-equity-ru.text: Faculty guidelines provide that in the interest of equity and fairness, faculty may not require a student to use an AI tool that is not provided by UCD.

evidence.quote: In the interest of equity and fairness, faculty may not require a student to use an AI tool that is not provided by UCD.
